title: Jump Game
summary: Given an integer array where each element indicates the maximum jump length from that position, determine if reaching the last index is possible.
statement: Given an integer array where each element indicates the maximum jump length from that position, determine if reaching the last index is possible. Return true if reachable, otherwise false.
constraints: 1–10,000 entries; each maximum jump length is 0–100,000.
Start at index zero and decide whether the final index can be reached. Shorter jumps than the maximum are allowed.
hints: Reachable forward positions form a prefix ending at a farthest known index.
Every reachable position may extend that prefix; no unreachable position can help.
If index exceeds farthest, fail. Otherwise maximize farthest with index+nums[index], succeeding once it reaches the end.
A zero is only fatal when no earlier reachable position can jump past it.
editorial: Maintain the farthest position reachable from all already scanned reachable indices. If the scan reaches a position beyond that frontier, no earlier jump can cross the gap, so the destination is unreachable. Otherwise extend the frontier with the current endpoint. Reaching or passing the last index proves success. A single-element input is already at its destination. The oracle independently traverses the directed graph of legal jumps.

tests.explanation: Index 1 is reachable from 0 and can then reach index 4.
Every possible route stops at or before the zero at index 3, leaving the last index unreachable.
